mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, we have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 32 degrees and a waxing crescent moon visible overhead.

The City of Verona welcomes Deputy Chief Liz Gay to the team starting November 2. She brings extensive experience in emergency medical services and administration to our community. Additionally, please remember that winter street parking regulations begin November 20.

There is a lot happening in Verona, starting with Live Music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy Live Music at Lake Lou-ee, and on Saturday, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market or music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man who was unresponsive behind the wheel at an intersection and subsequently arrested him for an O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
